audience: real estate photography businesses that deliver property sites and orders in HDPhotoHub

useCases.title: Find clients with an unpaid balance
useCases.text: List the orders of a client or a site and read the total and balance due. Use it to see who still owes money before you deliver more work.

useCases.title: Review all sites of one agent
useCases.text: Find the sites for an agent by email or by address text. Then open one site to see its status, purchase state and media items.

useCases.title: Put the best photo first on a property site
useCases.text: Read the media of a site, then send the new order of media ids so the hero photo comes first. Confirm the new order before you apply it.

useCases.title: Create a site for a new shoot
useCases.text: Look up the client, then create a property site for the address. Set the site status when the shoot is ready to share.

useCases.title: Check the payment history of a client
useCases.text: List the transactions of one client, optionally in a date range. Use it to answer a billing question without opening the dashboard.
